reviews.text: A staple for me, dont trust the ones you can buy on Amazon either! I use these at the end of a run of nightshifts rather than every week as they are richer and more enriching than my more day-to-day patch. I feel they undo the damage done and make me feel fresh for an event/girls night/dinner. Dont move at all once on.
reviews.zh: 係我必備嘅產品，亞馬遜上面賣嗰啲都唔好信！我係連續做完幾個夜更之後先用，唔係每個星期都用，因為佢哋比我日常用嗰款更厚、更滋潤。我覺得佢哋可以修復已經造成嘅損害，令我去活動、姊妹夜或者食飯都精神飽滿。一貼上就唔好郁。

reviews.shade: numbuzin No.9 NAD Collagen Under Eye Patches 5ea
reviews.text: The numbuzin No.9 NAD+ Eye Patches feel cooling and refreshing right away, perfect for mornings or when your eyes look tired. They stick well, don’t slide, and ingredients like NAD+, collagen, peptides, and caffeine help with puffiness, fine lines, and brightness. Results aren’t instant, but with regular use the under‑eye area looks more hydrated and firmer. Plus, the purple design makes them feel a bit luxe.
reviews.zh: numbuzin No.9 NAD+ Eye Patches 貼上即刻有清涼舒爽嘅感覺，好啱朝早或者眼睛攰嗰陣用。貼得穩、唔會滑落，而且 NAD+、膠原蛋白、肽同咖啡因等成分，有助改善眼浮腫、細紋同亮度。效果唔係即刻見到，但係恆常用嘅話，眼周睇落會更水潤、更緊緻。加上紫色嘅設計，令人覺得有啲奢華感。

reviews.text: Не могу сказать что я в восторге от патчей, но в общем не плохо. Ночью держатся, иногда спадают среди ночи. Кожа после них более гладкая. Впрочем как и после любых патчей
reviews.zh: 唔可以話我好鍾意呢款眼膜，不過整體都唔差。夜晚都貼得住，有時晚上會跌落嚟。用完之後皮膚比較滑，不過其實用任何眼膜之後都係咁。

reviews.text: These overnight patches leave my skin looking refreshed, hydrated, and noticeably smoother by morning. They adhere comfortably throughout the night and help improve the appearance of fine lines and dullness. A great addition to any skincare routine.
reviews.zh: 呢款隔夜眼膜，朝早醒嚟皮膚睇落精神、水潤，而且明顯滑咗好多。成晚都貼得好舒服，有助改善細紋同暗啞嘅感覺。係任何護膚程序都好好嘅加分產品。

reviews.text: These eye patches are excellent, very convenient, and contain a lot of active ingredients. I use them along with the same brand's eye cream, and it gives my skin a radiant, lifted appearance.

reviews.text:
overnight” in the name, but the product description is a bit confusing: in one part it says 20 minutes, in another “after you get enough rest.”
The “selfie” element isn’t very clear either. I think it was meant to make them viral — in theory, they should have an iridescent effect under flash. They do sparkle a little, but even with phone camera selfies the result is subtle and a bit underwhelming.
I tried them overnight — they dry out and don’t stick until morning, just leaving stiff, crinkled leaves. But… after about 1 hour, the change is real: puffiness gone, dark circles visibly reduced, and the under-eye looks fresher and smoother.
So while they’re not a true overnight patch in practice, they do work quickly if you want a visible eye-area refresh before an event or photos.
reviews.zh:
產品名字有「overnight」，但係產品介紹有啲混亂：一處寫 20 分鐘，另一處就寫「瞓夠覺之後」。
「selfie」嗰個元素都唔係好清楚。我諗佢哋原本係想令產品爆紅——理論上，喺閃光燈下應該會有珠光效果。佢哋會閃少少，但係即使用手機自拍，效果都好細微，有啲令人失望。
我試過成晚都貼——佢哋會乾返，一直到朝早都唔會貼實，只係留低硬邦邦、皺曲咗嘅眼膜。不過……大約一個鐘之後，變化係真嘅：浮腫消咗，黑眼圈明顯淡咗，眼周睇落更清新、更滑。
所以，雖然實際上佢哋唔算係真正嘅隔夜眼膜，但係如果你想喺活動或者影相之前，快速令眼周有明顯嘅煥發感，佢哋都真係見效快。
